name: 35079 · Hayden, AL
findings: ZIP 35079 (Hayden) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35079 (Hayden) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 35079 (Hayden) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 43% of the typical level).
